children: Barring further tightening by the Reserve Bank of Australia, the pace of monthly Australian house price falls will slow in the months ahead, with the housing market bottoming out early next year, says Abhijit Surya, senior economist at Capital Economics. Still, the outlook for monetary policy has become less certain, given that inflation is far too high for the RBA's liking, he adds. Continued upward pressure on rents won't help matters either, he says. If the RBA were to push ahead with further tightening, expect to see a steeper peak-to-trough fall, he adds. Capital Economics currently expects a 7% drop. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
